data.description:
Placeholder epic for Plan E from the UI/UX quality proposal (report: docs/proposals).

Problem: Today's spatial-layout.json has a free-text spatial_hint field. Sub-agents reading it have no enforceable contract about spacing/density intent — they invent values. The ui-designer agent itself ships designs without committing to numeric spacing constraints.

Deliverables:
- Extend spatial-layout.json schema: every container element must declare spacing_token (must reference an existing token in .claude/design.md), density_target (compact/comfortable/spacious mapping to whitespace_ratio ranges), alignment_anchor (which sibling/parent edge anchors it).
- Update plugins/dso/agents/ui-designer.md Steps 12 and 14 to populate these fields.
- plugins/dso/scripts/validate-spatial-layout.sh: mechanical validation against .claude/design.md tokens, invoked by the design-review skill.
- Plan C metrics script consumes density_target so thresholds are per-component, not global.

Maps to: Paradigm 1 (Semantic Grafting) in docs/proposals UI design report.

Dependency: pays off only after Plan A (tokens) and pairs with Plan B or C (metrics).

Measurable outcome: % of UI tasks where implementing sub-agent diverges from designer-stated density_target. Drives down implementation drift.

Status: placeholder — requires /dso:brainstorm to expand into a full epic spec.
data.title: Plan E: Semantic grafting of spatial intent into design manifest schema
